title: Intel's guide-down drags chips lower in a week of record memory profits and still-rising hyperscaler capex
intro: Earnings week split the supply chain: SK hynix and Samsung posted record quarters with HBM sold out into 2027 and beyond, and Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft kept spending heavily, but Intel's weak fourth-quarter outlook and margin cut helped pull foundry, compute and packaging names down. The financing side kept growing too, with a reported $63B lease vehicle for Broadcom chips bound for Anthropic.
movers_note: Tracked value fell 4.2% from Monday's Oct 26 close to $29.06T at the Oct 30 close (down 3.2% from the Oct 23 close a week earlier); Intel (-27.3%), Marvell (-16.0%), Delta Electronics (-14.4%, from its Oct 22 close), UMC (-13.0%) and Alphabet (-11.7%) fell most, while Vertiv (+16.4%), Advantest (+12.2%), SK hynix (+11.2%), Entegris (+10.1%) and Quanta Services (+10.1%) gained most.

items.headline: Intel guides Q4 revenue to $15.0-16.0B and margins lower despite a 78% jump in data-center sales
items.summary: Intel's Q3 revenue rose 21% to $16.5B and Data Center and AI revenue climbed 78% to $7.3B, but it guided Q4 revenue to $15.0-16.0B with a 38.0% non-GAAP gross margin, versus 44.1% in Q3. Management said the PC slowdown should last at least through the first half of 2027 and that freeing up Xeon supply is its top priority.

items.headline: SK hynix posts record Q3 as HBM4 ramps; AI memory sold out through 2029, 100T won payout
items.summary: SK hynix reported revenue of 104.6T won and operating profit of 83.33T won, roughly an 80% margin, and expects HBM4 to overtake HBM3E in Q4. It says HBM and other AI DRAM are sold out through 2029, more than half of 2027-28 capacity is under long-term contracts, and it announced a 100T won shareholder return plan.

items.headline: Samsung books record Q3 as HBM4 revenue triples; 2027 HBM sold out, 2026 capex set at 84.4T won
items.summary: Samsung reported Q3 operating profit of 107.44T won on revenue of 195.25T won. HBM4 revenue more than tripled to about 60% of HBM sales, 2027 HBM supply is already sold out, and 2026 capex is planned at a record 84.4T won.

items.headline: Banks and Blackstone line up $63B to finance Broadcom AI chips leased to Anthropic
items.summary: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley are funding a vehicle that will buy Broadcom accelerators and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic, with about $43.5B of first-lien debt and deliveries from 2027. Broadcom gives lenders residual-value support.

items.headline: Alphabet's quarterly capex reaches $51.4B as Google Cloud revenue more than doubles to $30.7B
items.summary: Alphabet's revenue rose 25% to $127.6B and Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B. Purchases of property and equipment were $51.36B in the quarter and $131.95B year to date, against $23.95B a year earlier.

items.headline: Amazon keeps 2026 capex near $220B as AWS grows 39% and free cash flow turns negative
items.summary: Amazon still expects about $220B of cash capex in 2026; AWS sales grew 39% to about $46.0B, and trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was an outflow of $42.4B. It also highlighted TorchNeuron, which runs existing PyTorch code on Trainium.

items.headline: TSMC reportedly weighs CoWoS price increases of up to 20% as packaging lead times stretch
items.summary: Taiwan's Commercial Times, relayed by TrendForce, reports TSMC may lift CoWoS prices by up to 20% and that foundries and OSATs are weighing 10-20% rounds; TSMC has not confirmed it. Equipment lead times have reportedly stretched to six to eight months, and wafer prices may rise 3-6% from January 2027.

items.headline: Microsoft's Azure grows 48% as Microsoft Cloud revenue reaches $63.9B
items.summary: For the quarter ended Sept. 30, Microsoft's revenue rose 19% to $92.3B, Azure grew 48%, and Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 30% to $63.9B.
